# FavGrab

> Free browser-based toolkit for web developers. Download favicons from any domain, and convert images between PNG, JPG, JFIF, WebP, AVIF, HEIC, TIFF, BMP, and ICO — entirely client-side, with no uploads.

FavGrab runs as a single-page application. All image processing happens in the visitor's browser using Canvas, WebCodecs, and lazy-loaded WebAssembly codecs (libheif-js for HEIC/HEIF, utif2 for TIFF, @jsquash/avif for AVIF encode). No file ever leaves the user's device. There is no account, no analytics tracking individual users, and no paid tier.

## Tools

- [Favicon Downloader](https://favgrab.boldkit.dev/): Enter any domain, get its favicon at sizes 16, 32, 48, 64, 128, or 256 pixels. Export as PNG, WebP, or JPG. Powered by Google's FaviconV2 service as the upstream source.
- [Image Converter](https://favgrab.boldkit.dev/convert): Drop one or more images. Decode formats: PNG, JPG, JFIF, WebP, AVIF, GIF (first frame), BMP, ICO, HEIC, HEIF, TIFF. Encode formats: PNG, JPG, JFIF, WebP, AVIF, BMP, ICO. Supports per-file quality (1–100) for lossy outputs, optional max-side resize with aspect preserved, and batch download as a streaming ZIP. (JFIF is the standard JPEG container — same bytes as JPG, different extension.)

## Conversion guides

Static, no-JS landing pages explaining a specific conversion. Each links into the live converter.

- [Image Converter — hub](https://favgrab.boldkit.dev/image-converter): Overview of every supported conversion, both directions, with links to each guide.
- [HEIC to JPG](https://favgrab.boldkit.dev/convert/heic-to-jpg): Turn iPhone HEIC photos into universal JPG files.
- [HEIC to PNG](https://favgrab.boldkit.dev/convert/heic-to-png): Convert iPhone HEIC images to lossless PNG.
- [HEIC to WebP](https://favgrab.boldkit.dev/convert/heic-to-webp): Convert iPhone HEIC photos straight to lightweight WebP for the web.
- [WebP to PNG](https://favgrab.boldkit.dev/convert/webp-to-png): Save downloaded .webp images as standard PNG, transparency preserved.
- [WebP to JPG](https://favgrab.boldkit.dev/convert/webp-to-jpg): Turn .webp images into universal JPG files.
- [PNG to WebP](https://favgrab.boldkit.dev/convert/png-to-webp): Compress PNG to lightweight WebP for faster sites.
- [JPG to WebP](https://favgrab.boldkit.dev/convert/jpg-to-webp): Compress JPG/JPEG photos to smaller WebP.
- [PNG to JPG](https://favgrab.boldkit.dev/convert/png-to-jpg): Shrink PNG files to compact JPG with quality control.
- [JPG to PNG](https://favgrab.boldkit.dev/convert/jpg-to-png): Convert JPG/JPEG to lossless PNG for editing.
- [JFIF to PNG](https://favgrab.boldkit.dev/convert/jfif-to-png): Turn a stubborn .jfif file into a universal lossless PNG.
- [JFIF to JPG](https://favgrab.boldkit.dev/convert/jfif-to-jpg): Rename a confusing .jfif to a standard .jpg — same JPEG data.
- [JFIF to WebP](https://favgrab.boldkit.dev/convert/jfif-to-webp): Convert a .jfif image to lightweight WebP for the web.
- [PNG to JFIF](https://favgrab.boldkit.dev/convert/png-to-jfif): Convert PNG to JFIF (standard JPEG) when a system asks for .jfif.
- [JPG to JFIF](https://favgrab.boldkit.dev/convert/jpg-to-jfif): Give a JPG the .jfif extension some forms and systems require.
- [AVIF to PNG](https://favgrab.boldkit.dev/convert/avif-to-png): Save next-gen .avif images as universal PNG, transparency preserved.
- [AVIF to JPG](https://favgrab.boldkit.dev/convert/avif-to-jpg): Turn .avif images into universal JPG files.
- [PNG to AVIF](https://favgrab.boldkit.dev/convert/png-to-avif): Compress PNG to next-gen AVIF for the smallest high-quality web files.
- [JPG to AVIF](https://favgrab.boldkit.dev/convert/jpg-to-avif): Compress JPG/JPEG photos to next-gen AVIF for maximum compression.
- [GIF to PNG](https://favgrab.boldkit.dev/convert/gif-to-png): Convert a GIF (first frame) to a full-colour lossless PNG still.
- [TIFF to PNG](https://favgrab.boldkit.dev/convert/tiff-to-png): Convert large TIFF scans to lossless PNG that opens anywhere.
- [TIFF to JPG](https://favgrab.boldkit.dev/convert/tiff-to-jpg): Shrink large TIFF scans to compact, shareable JPG files.
- [BMP to PNG](https://favgrab.boldkit.dev/convert/bmp-to-png): Convert bulky uncompressed BMP bitmaps to compact lossless PNG.
- [PNG to ICO](https://favgrab.boldkit.dev/convert/png-to-ico): Generate a favicon.ico or Windows icon from a PNG.
- [JPG to ICO](https://favgrab.boldkit.dev/convert/jpg-to-ico): Generate a favicon.ico or Windows icon from a JPG.
